description: This file contains shell functions for managing firmware upgrades on Linksys devices running OpenWrt. It includes functions for determining firmware target partitions, performing upgrades, and copying configuration backups.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition based on current boot settings or UBI configuration.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process using specified image, handling different magic numbers for partition selection.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration to the designated directory.
